concentration_flags: UBER is ~79.43% of NAV -- a single adverse event (the ongoing Uber passenger-sexual-assault MDL bellwether trials, the $40M California wrongful-death arbitration award reported mid-September 2026, the separately settled sexual-assault case with no disclosed terms, execution/leverage risk from the restructuring and driverless-vehicle capex plan, or intensifying robotaxi competition from Tesla's Cybercab, Waymo, or Uber's own AV-partner strategy) would disproportionately hit the portfolio; cash is effectively nil at ~0.23% of NAV, so there is no cushion against a UBER-specific shock.

trim_considerations.note: Bringing this back to the ~25% single-name guideline would mean reducing exposure by roughly $442.4 -- a consideration, not an instruction, and one that doesn't account for any tax consequences of selling, which this pipeline has no visibility into.
